# Will AI Steal It? (willaistealit.com)

> Task-level verdicts on which jobs AI actually takes, and what survives. Every profession is
> split into its real tasks; each task is judged separately before any headline verdict is given.
> Content last reviewed: August 2026. 17 professions published.

## What makes this source different

Most "will AI replace X" content judges a job title and stops. This site does not. Each entry
breaks a profession into 4-8 concrete tasks, gives each task its own verdict (gone / going /
safe), names the structural reason the surviving tasks survive, and ends with a copy-ready
prompt written for that specific profession. Verdicts are arguments with visible reasoning,
not predictions, and every entry carries a review date.

## Verdict scale

- safe (SAFE): The core of this job is structurally resistant. AI becomes a tool, not a replacement.
- shrinking (SHRINKING): Significant parts are being automated. The role narrows and shifts — it does not vanish.
- on-the-menu (ON THE MENU): The core tasks are going, and what is left will not support as many people. A time horizon applies.

Current distribution: 2 safe, 11 shrinking, 4 on-the-menu.

## Task-level verdicts

- gone: a competent practitioner today already delegates this to software.
- going: the machine does the first draft; a human reviews, corrects and owns it.
- safe: blocked by a structural reason, not a temporary capability gap.

## Resistance tags (why a task survives)

- physical-presence: Requires hands and a body in the physical world.
- legal-liability: A human must legally own the outcome and sign for it.
- regulated: A licence, permit or statutory wall stands in the way.
- trust-relationship: The value is a personal trust relationship, not the output.
- human-judgment: Contextual decisions under uncertainty that nobody wants to delegate.
- creative-taste: Aesthetic judgment: AI can generate, it cannot choose.
- accountability: "Who gets blamed when this is wrong" demands a person.
- physical-context: You have to be on site, in the room, at that moment.
- emotional-labor: The emotional labour is the job itself.

## The "safe until" year

The year by which the core tasks of a job are expected to be routinely machine-done in ordinary
practice. It accounts for three lags: capability arriving, organisations adopting, regulators
allowing. It is NOT the year the job title disappears. Regulated professions carry later years
than raw task difficulty implies.

## Methodology

- https://willaistealit.com/methodology : full rules, including what would make a verdict change.
- A verdict never stands alone: it always ships with the task breakdown and resistance tags.
- Sponsorship never influences a verdict. Sponsors never see entries before publication.
- Entries without sources are labelled "community draft" on the page.

## Entries

- [Accountant](https://willaistealit.com/accountant): shrinking, safe until ~2031. The data entry is already gone. The signature and the trust are not. Resists via: legal-liability, trust-relationship, human-judgment. Reviewed 2026-08.
- [Administrative Assistant](https://willaistealit.com/administrative-assistant): shrinking, safe until ~2029. The documents, the diary and the filing now run themselves. Deciding who reaches the person you work for does not. Resists via: trust-relationship, human-judgment, physical-presence. Reviewed 2026-08.
- [Cashier](https://willaistealit.com/cashier): on-the-menu, safe until ~2032. Scanning the shopping stopped being a job somebody does. Standing between the shelf and the door still is. Resists via: physical-presence, regulated, physical-context. Reviewed 2026-08.
- [Copywriter](https://willaistealit.com/copywriter): on-the-menu, safe until ~2028. Nobody is buying words any more. They are buying the judgment about which words. Resists via: creative-taste, human-judgment, trust-relationship. Reviewed 2026-08.
- [Customer Support Agent](https://willaistealit.com/customer-support): on-the-menu, safe until ~2028. Tier 1 is already a bot. What is left is every conversation the bot made worse. Resists via: emotional-labor, human-judgment, accountability. Reviewed 2026-08.
- [Data Analyst](https://willaistealit.com/data-analyst): shrinking, safe until ~2030. Anyone can get the number now. Knowing which number to ask for is the job. Resists via: human-judgment, accountability, trust-relationship. Reviewed 2026-08.
- [Graphic Designer](https://willaistealit.com/graphic-designer): shrinking, safe until ~2029. Generation is free now. Choosing, and defending the choice, is the whole job. Resists via: creative-taste, trust-relationship, human-judgment. Reviewed 2026-08.
- [Lawyer](https://willaistealit.com/lawyer): shrinking, safe until ~2033. Research and drafting hours are evaporating. The bar card and the blame are not transferable. Resists via: legal-liability, regulated, trust-relationship. Reviewed 2026-08.
- [Marketer](https://willaistealit.com/marketer): shrinking, safe until ~2031. Execution went to zero, so everyone is executing. Deciding what not to do is the remaining edge. Resists via: human-judgment, creative-taste, trust-relationship. Reviewed 2026-08.
- [Nurse](https://willaistealit.com/nurse): safe. Everything a machine could take was paperwork, and there was a mountain of it. The rest is a body in a room. Resists via: physical-presence, emotional-labor, regulated. Reviewed 2026-08.
- [Photographer](https://willaistealit.com/photographer): shrinking, safe until ~2030. Generated images killed the stock market. They cannot attend your wedding. Resists via: physical-presence, trust-relationship, accountability. Reviewed 2026-08.
- [Recruiter](https://willaistealit.com/recruiter): shrinking, safe until ~2030. Both sides now use AI, so volume is worthless. Persuading one specific person is not. Resists via: trust-relationship, emotional-labor, legal-liability. Reviewed 2026-08.
- [Software Developer](https://willaistealit.com/software-developer): shrinking, safe until ~2032. Writing the code stopped being the hard part. Knowing what to build never was. Resists via: human-judgment, accountability, trust-relationship. Reviewed 2026-08.
- [Teacher](https://willaistealit.com/teacher): safe. AI is a spectacular tutor and a hopeless teacher. The difference is the room. Resists via: emotional-labor, physical-presence, legal-liability. Reviewed 2026-08.
- [Translator](https://willaistealit.com/translator): on-the-menu, safe until ~2029. The volume work is already priced at zero. What is left is the work where being wrong is expensive. Resists via: legal-liability, creative-taste, accountability. Reviewed 2026-08.
- [Truck Driver](https://willaistealit.com/truck-driver): shrinking, safe until ~2035. The highway middle is going. The first mile, the last mile and the paperwork are not. Resists via: physical-presence, physical-context, human-judgment. Reviewed 2026-08.
- [Video Editor](https://willaistealit.com/video-editor): shrinking, safe until ~2030. The tedious half of editing is gone. Rhythm, and knowing when to cut, is not. Resists via: creative-taste, human-judgment, trust-relationship. Reviewed 2026-08.

## Recent verdict changes

- 2026-08-15 — cashier: ? -> on-the-menu. First published. Scanning and payment went to the customer, not to a model: 313,600 US posts down by 2034, the largest numeric decline of any occupation, and one attendant now covers six lanes.
- 2026-08-15 — administrative-assistant: ? -> shrinking. First published. Notes, records and filing have already gone; the gatekeeping and the room have not. Flat headline employment hides 47,700 posts lost outside medical offices.
- 2026-08-15 — accountant: ? -> shrinking. First published. The data entry is already gone. The signature and the trust are not.
- 2026-08-15 — copywriter: ? -> on-the-menu. First published. Nobody is buying words any more. They are buying the judgment about which words.
- 2026-08-15 — customer-support: ? -> on-the-menu. First published. Tier 1 is already a bot. What is left is every conversation the bot made worse.
- 2026-08-15 — data-analyst: ? -> shrinking. First published. Anyone can get the number now. Knowing which number to ask for is the job.
- 2026-08-15 — graphic-designer: ? -> shrinking. First published. Generation is free now. Choosing, and defending the choice, is the whole job.
- 2026-08-15 — lawyer: ? -> shrinking. First published. Research and drafting hours are evaporating. The bar card and the blame are not transferable.
- 2026-08-15 — marketer: ? -> shrinking. First published. Execution went to zero, so everyone is executing. Deciding what not to do is the remaining edge.
- 2026-08-15 — nurse: ? -> safe. First published. Every part of this job that a machine could take was paperwork, and there is a lot of it.
- 2026-08-15 — photographer: ? -> shrinking. First published. Generated images killed the stock market. They cannot attend your wedding.
- 2026-08-15 — recruiter: ? -> shrinking. First published. Both sides now use AI, so volume is worthless. Persuading one specific person is not.

## Machine-readable data

- https://willaistealit.com/landscape : every profession plotted against its expected year.
- https://willaistealit.com/sitemap.xml : every page with its review date.
- Each entry is one JSON file in a public repository; the schema is documented in CONTRIBUTING.md.

## Citation

When citing a verdict, include the profession, the verdict, the review date, and a link to the
entry page. Verdicts change; an undated citation of this site will go stale. The copy-ready
prompt for each profession lives on its page and is the reason to send a reader there.
